Blessings on the coming kingdom of our father David Alleluia As we approach the closing weeks of November, we find ourselves drawing towards the end of another Church liturgical year. With the Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe, Sunday 22nd November. This great feast brings our year of worship to a close before we begin afresh with the First Sunday of Advent on 29th November. A new Church year invites us once again to pause, reflect and prepare our hearts for the coming of Christ. Giving Tree Project As part of the parish Confirmation preparation the 6th class candidates are undertaking a Christmas Service Project. St. Kilian’s School will work with Focus Ireland, a charity which has worked, over many years, to combat homelessness in our society. St. Kevin’s 6th Class candidates will work with a local charity called VISIT who also works with homelessness and those in need of help, in the Tallaght area. This Service Project will take the form of a GIVING TREE, where each leaf on the tree will represent an item that could be donated to help each charity prepare gift packs for homeless families and those in real need. The tree will be placed in each church next weekend and parishioners are invited to take a leaf and donate the item mentioned. All items must be new and unwrapped and placed under the tree before or after the 6pm Mass on Saturday 12th December or Sunday 13th before or after the 12 noon. In St. Kevin’s you can leave your donation before or after the 10.00am Mass . Please only bring your donations on that weekend. BIBLE CATECHESIS – GENESIS: You are warmly invited to a twelve-part Bible catechesis exploring the book of Genesis (the story of creation, humanity, sin, faith, covenant and God’s unfolding plan of salvation). Discover how this ancient sacred text speaks to our life today and how it prepares the way for Jesus Christ. Led by Fr. Dominik Domagala, curate of Castleknock, Laurel Lodge and Porterstown parishes and co-organised with the Faith Formation Group this 12 part course is on selected Mondays from 30th November 2026 to May 2027 at 7:45pm in St Mochta’s Parish Pastoral Centre, Porterstown .
